# Shipwright Studio

> Shipwright Studio is an independent engineering studio crafting websites, web apps, and AI infrastructure for startups and small teams. Based in the San Francisco Bay Area, working worldwide. Founded and run by a senior software engineer.

## Services

- **Custom website development**: Fast, accessible, search-friendly marketing sites and landing pages. Modern stack, no bloated templates.
- **Web application development**: Interactive dashboards, internal tools, and customer-facing apps — designed, engineered, and deployed end to end.
- **AI infrastructure**: LLM application engineering, inference cost optimization, GPU communication and distributed training performance.

## Selected work

- **Lumen** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lumen/): An interactive photography lab that teaches the exposure triangle (aperture, shutter speed, ISO) with real-time canvas simulations of depth of field, motion blur, noise, and light metering.
- **Forge** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/forge/): An LLM inference cost estimator. Enter model size, quantization, GPU type, batch size, and traffic to estimate GPU count, latency, and monthly serving cost.
- **The Lab** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/ideas/): An open bank of 132 web experiments — games, developer tools, browser extension prototypes, and small apps. Two new experiments are designed, built, and shipped every day. Recent additions: **Breakout** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/breakout/), a brick-breaker game — ninety bricks, classic row scoring (top row pays most), level speed-up and a shrinking paddle, playable with mouse, keyboard or touch, **Simon Says** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/simon-says/), a memory game — four light-and-tone pads play a growing sequence you repeat under strict rules, with playback that speeds up as you survive, plus **Markdown Live** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/markdown-preview/), a split-pane markdown editor with instant preview — headings, tables, code blocks and task lists rendered in-browser, with toolbar formatting, HTML export and draft autosave, **Kelly Criterion Calculator** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/kelly-calculator/), a position-sizing tool that computes the Kelly-optimal bankroll fraction from win probability and payoff odds — full/half/quarter Kelly stakes, expected-growth curve with ruin-zone shading, and per-bet dollar stakes, **Options Payoff Lab** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/options-payoff/), a multi-leg option strategy payoff diagram builder with breakevens, max profit/loss and Black-Scholes deltas, **Tetris** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/tetris/), the classic falling-block game with 7-bag randomizer, ghost piece, hold queue and level speed-up, plus **Regex Tester** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/regex-tester/), a live regex workbench — type a pattern and see matches highlighted in place, inspect capture groups match by match, toggle flags, and consult the built-in cheatsheet, **Event Countdown** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/event-countdown/), a flip-digit countdown timer for any event — name it, pick a date, watch days/hours/minutes/seconds flip down, and share it with a link, and **2048** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/game-2048/).

## Process

1. Discovery call — goals, scope, and constraints.
2. Proposal — fixed scope, timeline, and price.
3. Build — weekly demos, no surprises.
4. Launch — deployed, measured, handed over with documentation.

## Contact

- The studio does not publish an email address. Use the contact form: https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/#contact
- Typical response time: within one business day.

## About the format of this file

This file follows the llms.txt convention (https://llmstxt.org/): a concise, markdown-formatted summary of this site intended for AI assistants and answer engines.
